# Noto Sans CJK SC

Unmodified static OpenType fonts, release Sans2.004 (font version 2.004).
Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/), as recorded in the font name table.
Licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LICENSE and ../../../LICENSES/OFL-1.1.txt.

Source: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/tree/Sans2.004/Sans/OTF/SimplifiedChinese

Regular, Medium and Bold are embedded by tools/embed_cjk_font.py at build time as
raw-DEFLATE resources. The font files themselves are neither subsetted nor modified.
Chinese characters and fullwidth punctuation use this family before system fallbacks;
The CJK em is normalized to 90% of the base UI line height (the upstream font
has a 1000-unit em and a 1448-unit ascender/descender box), with the same ratio
for every role and DPI scale. Latin text and numbers retain Inter / JetBrains Mono / the Classic system monospace font.
The full SC faces retain the upstream CJK coverage for received text and user input,
rather than only the characters currently used by the interface translations.
